thread:
ellie: quick flag: on the q7 compact bring-up I'm seeing weird reordering for CJK with inline Arabic ruby. Parentheses hop and Arabic numbers get mirrored. minimal repro and cmd below.
chen: paste the run + tiny input please
ellie: ran the local smoke on cpu_pack fallback:
```
./scripts/run_local_eval --model=repo/juno-compact:q7 --suite=locale_probe --input=tests/jp_ar_ruby.json --batch=1
```
input (literal):
歌詞（مرحباً ۱۲۳）ふりがな

observed output:
（مرحباً ٣٢١）歌詞ふりがな

note: Arabic-Indic digits became mirrored ۱۲۳->٣٢١ and the closing paren moved in front of the CJK closing marker.
sofia: metrics: fp16 baseline BLEU 30.0 -> juno-q7 19.6 on this probe. chrF -6.0. token mismatches +49/180; spike concentrated on short embedded RTL spans inside fullwidth punctuation.
chen: quick check across quant levels?
ellie: q8 dynamic -> clean. q6 -> small jitter. q7 worst. only occurs when runtime.fallback=cpu_pack_v2; GPU path ok so far.
eval-bot: auto-ticket: id=ml-probe-3745550000-k; model_sha=de9f1a; repo=infra/models/juno-compact; kernel=cpu_pack_v2
ellie: pack manifest excerpt used for q7:
```
quant_scheme: q7_dynamic
packer_opts: --compress-small --preserve-broken-zwsp=false
detok: bundled-detok-lite-v1
```
sofia: that preserve-broken-zwsp=false looks suspicious. We pushed bundled-detok-lite-v2 to fp16 packs which sets preserve-broken-zwsp=true and keeps U+200D for short spans.
chen: hypothesis: packer is collapsing U+200D -> U+200B for sequences below the compress threshold which removes shaping and bidi mirror flags; detok then concatenates in visual order causing paren reattachment.
ellie: uploaded logs to s3://redwood-triage/3745550000/juno-q7-logs.tar.gz and added sample id jp_ar_ruby_3745550000 to tests/locale_seeds.json
infra-bot: Canary hold: juno-compact q7 auto-promotion paused in us-east-1 until triage complete (reason: locale detok regression)
chen: triage plan: (1) rebuild q7 pack forcing preserve-broken-zwsp=true and detok v2; (2) if repro disappears, update packer defaults for q6/q7; (3) otherwise bisect cpu_pack_v2 detok path and add instrumentation to token-unpack to diff codepoints vs fp16 artifact.
sofia: add a focused unit test to locale_probe asserting bracket attachment + numeric orientation for a handful of mixed annotation cases. make it a pre-promote gate for quant packs.
ellie: mitigation: routing rule to prefer juno-compact-fp16 for locales that include multiorient+rtl until we ship the fix. rollback trigger: BLEU delta >4 on canary OR error spike >2/min.
chen: I'll start the repack and post results. if anyone wants to help bisect the packer threshold, ping me.
sofia: thanks team  I'll take the test PR. also adding a small fuzz corpus for short-embedding cases so we don't miss the next one.
ellie: marking this monitored for now. reactions: :mag_right: :white_check_mark:
